findings.issue: The team cookie protocol is implemented twice (server in lib/team.ts, client here) with different validation, and MAX_TEAM_SIZE is duplicated; the two can drift
findings.suggestion: Extract a single shared module (validation, size limit, encode/decode) imported by both lib/team.ts and the Base script — Astro scripts can import the same module

findings.issue: Module-level cache never evicts; it grows with every distinct path ever requested (species, pokemon, moves, abilities…)
findings.suggestion: Cap the cache (LRU by size or entries) or accept stale-and-replace with a bounded key set

findings.issue: No fetch timeout, and the 24-slot concurrency limiter is global: one hung API endpoint stalls all in-flight page renders
findings.suggestion: Add AbortSignal.timeout() to load(), and consider a per-request rather than process-global limiter

findings.issue: API_BASE_URL read from process.env; Astro has recommended astro:env/getSecret since v5
findings.suggestion: Define the variable in astro.config.mjs's env schema and import from astro:env/server

findings.issue: A failed background revalidate is swallowed and the entry is marked fresh for another 60s, delaying pickup of live data changes
findings.suggestion: Only update hit.at on successful refresh, or retry sooner on failure

findings.issue: '<n> of 6' is derived from the raw cookie while the card list and coverage come from members filtered against the live API, so they can disagree if a name 404s
findings.suggestion: Count from the resolved members list, or drop unresolved names from the cookie on render

findings.issue: Pervasive 'any' props and locals across components contradict the astro/tsconfigs/strict tsconfig; no astro check in the build
findings.suggestion: Type the API payload shapes once in lib, and add @astrojs/check (astro check) to the build or CI

findings.issue: The show()/dash formatting helper is duplicated in MovesSection.astro:85
findings.suggestion: Move show/sortValue into lib/pokedex.ts next to DASH

findings.issue: The shared layout carries team-specific behavior (cookie writes and reload) for every page, including ones with no team UI
findings.suggestion: Move the delegated click handler into a small dedicated script module (or TeamControls component) so the layout stays generic

findings.issue: Display helpers (humanize, dexNumber, DASH) share a module with data loaders; it will become the dumping ground as pages grow
findings.suggestion: Split formatting helpers into lib/format.ts so the data layer stays about fetching

summary: A clean, current-idiom Astro 7 SSR app: file-based routes, frontmatter data loading, Astro.cookies, Astro.self recursion, and thoughtful client scripts with abort controllers and correct 404 handling. The team feature was integrated the way I'd want, reusing existing components and rendering state server-side from a cookie with no flash. I'd merge after one round of nits: deduplicate the team-cookie protocol between server and client, adopt astro:env, bound the cache, add a fetch timeout, and tighten the pervasive anys.
